population: All T01..T16 sealed TRAIN windows. All source factorial rows from 6 windows/2 episodes. All original target forward returns, including two repeats. No new inference.
attribution: First derive action signature without object or phase labels: event takes priority (ordered OPEN/CLOSE); else dominant Cartesian sign X/Y/Z or STILL (max excursion <1 mm). Only then join scoring labels. Descriptive signature contingency; no explicit model phase head.
metrics: Use source world TCP path, first to last; distances to measured target and distractor at query; gt is scoring only. DESCEND requires net negative Z and >=1 mm approach to target; CLOSE requires a close and no open; LIFT requires +1 mm Z and no open; HOLD requires max excursion <=4 mm, angle<=2 deg, no open; CARRY requires +1 mm projected progress toward instructed zone and no open. Geometric signs separately. Single-window proxy only.
timing: Median/p95 actual returned forward wall time, all, first and warm per cold launch; join ID/seed/output hash and retain repeats.
decision: H0 known trajectory, H1 archived local proposal, H1 own-feedback rollout unmeasured, H2 phase output unobserved. No heldout or native success inferred.
